@page "/spreadsheet/data-validation"

@using Syncfusion.Blazor.Spreadsheet
@using System;
@using System.IO;

@*Hidden:Lines*@
@inherits SampleBaseComponent;
@inject NavigationManager NavigationManager
@*End:Hidden*@

<SampleDescription>
    <p>This sample demonstrates data validation in a gross pay calculation worksheet. Use the Blazor Spreadsheet to work with validated worksheet data.</p>
</SampleDescription>

<ActionDescription>
    <p>This sample demonstrates data validation in the Blazor Spreadsheet using a gross pay calculation worksheet. The worksheet provides the sample context for working with validated data. To enable data validation, set the <a href="https://help.syncfusion.com/cr/blazor/Syncfusion.Blazor.Spreadsheet.SfSpreadsheet.html#Syncfusion_Blazor_Spreadsheet_SfSpreadsheet_AllowDataValidation" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Navigate to the AllowDataValidation property documentation">AllowDataValidation</a> property to <strong>true</strong>. This allows users to apply validation rules to cells and ranges and restrict entries to acceptable values.</p>
    
    <p> Highlight invalid cells using the <a target="_blank" href="https://help.syncfusion.com/cr/blazor/Syncfusion.Blazor.Spreadsheet.SfSpreadsheet.html#Syncfusion_Blazor_Spreadsheet_SfSpreadsheet_ShowInvalidDataHighlights" aria-label="Navigate to the ShowInvalidDataHighlights property documentation">ShowInvalidDataHighlights</a> property. The default value is <strong>false</strong>.</p>
    <p><strong>Key Features</strong></p>
    <ul>
        <li><strong>Validation rules</strong> - Restrict entries in cells or ranges to acceptable values.</li>
        <li><strong>Validation criteria</strong> - Validate whole numbers, decimals, dates, times, text length, lists, and custom formulas.</li>
        <li><strong>Highlight Invalid Data</strong> - Identify invalid cells with a yellow background and red text.</li>
        <li><strong>Clear Validation</strong> - Remove validation rules from selected cells or ranges.</li>
        <li><strong>Worksheet validation</strong> - Apply rules through the <strong>Data</strong> tab in the ribbon.</li>
    </ul>
    <p>
        Apply data validation through the ribbon or use <a target="_blank" href="https://help.syncfusion.com/cr/blazor/Syncfusion.Blazor.Spreadsheet.SfSpreadsheet.html#Syncfusion_Blazor_Spreadsheet_SfSpreadsheet_AddDataValidationAsync_Syncfusion_Blazor_Spreadsheet_ValidationRule_" aria-label="Navigate to the Blazor Spreadsheet AddDataValidationAsync documentation">AddDataValidationAsync</a> and <a target="_blank" href="https://help.syncfusion.com/cr/blazor/Syncfusion.Blazor.Spreadsheet.SfSpreadsheet.html#Syncfusion_Blazor_Spreadsheet_SfSpreadsheet_RemoveDataValidationAsync_System_String_" aria-label="Navigate to the Blazor Spreadsheet RemoveDataValidationAsync documentation">RemoveDataValidationAsync</a> for programmatic validation rule management.
    </p>

    <p>Learn how to maintain accurate data entry by applying validation rules and identifying invalid values.</p>

    <p><strong>Documentation Links</strong></p>
    <ul>
        <li><a href="https://help.syncfusion.com/document-processing/excel/spreadsheet/blazor/cell-range#data-validation" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Navigate to the Blazor Spreadsheet Data Validation documentation">Data Validation</a></li>
        <li><a href="https://help.syncfusion.com/cr/blazor/Syncfusion.Blazor.Spreadsheet.SfSpreadsheet.html#Syncfusion_Blazor_Spreadsheet_SfSpreadsheet_AllowDataValidation" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Navigate to the AllowDataValidation property documentation">API Reference</a></li>
    </ul>

    <p><strong>More Resources</strong></p>
    <ul>
        <li><a href="https://github.com/SyncfusionExamples/blazor-spreadsheet-examples" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="View the sample in GitHub">View Sample in GitHub</a></li>
    </ul>
    <p>Looking for the full Blazor Spreadsheet Editor component overview, features, pricing, and documentation? Visit the <a rel="noopener" target='_blank' href='https://www.syncfusion.com/spreadsheet-editor-sdk/blazor-spreadsheet-editor' aria-label="Navigate to the Blazor Spreadsheet Editor FT page">Blazor Spreadsheet Editor component</a> page.</p>
</ActionDescription>

<div class="col-lg-12 control-section">
    <div class="content-wrapper">
        <div class="row">
            <div>
                <SfSpreadsheet DataSource="DataSourceBytes" ShowInvalidDataHighlights="true" @ref=_spreadsheetInstance>
                    <SpreadsheetRibbon></SpreadsheetRibbon>
                </SfSpreadsheet>
            </div>

        </div>
    </div>
</div>

@*Hidden:Lines*@
<style>
    .e-spreadsheet-protection-dialog label,
    .e-spreadsheet-unprotect-dialog label,
    .e-unprotectworkbook-dlg label,
    .e-spreadsheet-name-manager-content label {
        font-weight: normal !important;
        margin-bottom: 0 !important;
    }

    .e-protectworkbook-dlg label {
        font-weight: normal !important;
    }
</style>
@*End:Hidden*@

@code {
    public byte[] DataSourceBytes { get; set; }
    public SfSpreadsheet _spreadsheetInstance { get; set; }

    protected override void OnInitialized()
    {
        @*Server:Block*@
#if !(WASM)
        //Sets the excel file path for initial loading.
        string filePath = "wwwroot/data/spreadsheet/datavalidation.xlsx";
        DataSourceBytes = File.ReadAllBytes(filePath);
#endif
        @*End:Server*@

        @*WebAssembly:Block*@
#if (WASM)
    //Sets the excel file path for initial loading.
    string filePath = "";
    DataSourceBytes = Convert.FromBase64String(filePath);
#endif
        @*End:WebAssembly*@
    }

    @*Hidden:Lines*@
    @*WebAssembly:Block*@
#if (WASM)
    protected override void OnAfterRender(bool firstRender)
    {
        if (firstRender)
        {
            _spreadsheetInstance.CustomFonts = CustomFonts;
        }
    }

    public List<string> CustomFonts = new List<string>
    {
        "fonts/Arial.TTF",
        "fonts/Calibri.TTF",
        "fonts/Courier New.TTF",
        "fonts/Georgia.TTF",
        "fonts/Algerian.TTF",
        "fonts/Cambria.TTF",
        "fonts/Cambria Math.TTF",
        "fonts/Candara.TTF",
        "fonts/Impact.TTF",
        "fonts/Segoe Print.TTF",
        "fonts/Segoe UI.TTF",
        "fonts/Segoe Script.TTF",
        "fonts/Symbol.TTF",
        "fonts/Times New Roman.TTF",
        "fonts/Verdana.TTF",
        "fonts/Wingdings.TTF"
    };
#endif
    @*End:WebAssembly*@
    @*End:Hidden*@
}
